name: Chart
summary: Generic chart wrapper that consumes Lumen's CHART_PALETTE and chart-token surface (axes, grid, legend, tooltip). Eleven kinds via the `kind` enum — line / area / bar / stacked-bar / donut / pie / scatter / heatmap / sparkline / funnel / waterfall. Renders via the consumer's adapter (Recharts, Visx, ECharts) but the styling, axis layout, legend, and tooltip skin come from Lumen.

data.description: Adapter-shaped data. The wrapper is data-format-agnostic — the adapter (Recharts etc.) is the one that consumes shape.

color.description: Override the auto-derived palette stop. Defaults to CHART_PALETTE[0].

ariaSummary.description: 1-2 sentence prose summary of what the chart shows ('Sales up 12% week-over-week, peaking Wednesday'). Surfaced to SR users in place of axis values.

rules: aria-label names what the chart shows ('Sales by week, January through March').
aria-describedby points at the textual summary OR an offscreen <table> with the underlying data — chart data MUST be reachable for SR users.
Never rely on color alone for series differentiation — pair color with marker shape, dash pattern, or labels.

do: Use the CHART_PALETTE in order — chart.1 (accent green), chart.2 (info blue), chart.3 (warning amber), chart.4-8 (neutral tints). Series colors stay consistent across the surface.
Render axis labels in eyebrow-mono uppercase tracking-wider.
Tabular-nums on all numeric tick labels.
Pair every chart with a short prose summary (ariaSummary) — humans read it too.
Render the tooltip as a Lumen Popover skin (surface.popover, hairline border, shadow.popover).
dont: Don't paint every series in the brand accent — the accent is reserved for the primary metric or the active series.
Don't render charts without an aria-label or summary.
Don't put critical detail in chart-only — surface it in adjacent prose / KPI.

changelog.note: Initial Chart wrapper contract. Eleven kinds. Adapter-agnostic.
